name: talk2myagent
description: Local phone calls and human voice role-play tests, with a single Codex agent, speech models, recordings and transcripts.

interface.shortDescription: Call support or test a spoken role-play on your Mac.
interface.longDescription: Enter test mode and supply any call task; act as the recipient while the agent converses through the microphone and speakers. Or use Mac Phone calling. Both paths use local speech, recordings, and transcripts.
interface.defaultPrompt: Enter human role-play test mode and wait for me to describe the task.
